 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Bhola Prasad , Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Prem Kumar Jha, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order

3 07-10-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State .
2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 341 ,
342, 323 , 376 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code .
3 . It is alleged that petitioner made physical relation with informant on the false promise of marriage, and thereafter refused to marry .
4.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52479 of 2024(3) dt.07-10-2024 that petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.

From bare perusal of the F.I.R. it is apparent that both petitioner and informant enjoyed each other's company for more than two years and indulged in sexual act being fully aware of the consequences Md. sentences.text: of the relationship, as such, the same cannot be said to be induced or involuntary.
It is further submitted that the medical board has assessed the age of the victim between 17 to 19 years.
5 . Learned counsel for the State opposes the bail petition of the petitioner.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and also the fact that both the parties were major when the relationship developed between them and which continued for more than 2 years together and informant was well aware of such relationship and its consequences and as such, the same will not amount to any criminal offence , in the event of arrest or surrender within eight weeks from today,
let the petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-(ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned CJM Kishanganj in connection with Thakurganj P .S. case No. 48 of 2024 , subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52479 of 2024(3) dt.07-10-2024 Code of Criminal Procedure .
(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Koushik/-
